# Blocks, procs and lambdas: what each one does differently.

def with_yield
  return "no block given" unless block_given?

  "block returned #{yield(2)}"
end
puts "1. yield: #{with_yield { |n| n * 21 }}"
puts "2. no block: #{with_yield}"

adder = proc { |a, b| a + b }
puts "3. proc call: #{adder.call(1, 2)}, proc arity is lenient: #{adder.call(1, 2, 3)}"

strict = lambda { |a, b| a + b }
puts "4. lambda call: #{strict.call(1, 2)}, lambda arity: #{strict.arity}"

def method_arity_of(callable)
  callable.arity
end
puts "5. proc arity: #{method_arity_of(proc { |a, b| })}, lambda arity: #{method_arity_of(lambda { |a, b| })}"

def takes_block(&block)
  block.call("explicitly")
end
puts "6. explicit &block parameter: #{takes_block { |s| "called #{s}" }}"

def relay(&block)
  [1, 2, 3].map(&block)
end
puts "7. passing a block straight through with &: #{relay { |n| n**2 }.inspect}"

doubler = :to_s.to_proc

# Classes: state, behaviour, inheritance, and Comparable.

class Account
  include Comparable

  attr_reader :owner, :balance

  def initialize(owner, balance = 0)
    @owner = owner
    @balance = balance
  end

  def deposit(amount)
    raise ArgumentError, "amount must be positive" unless amount.positive?

    @balance += amount
    self
  end

  def <=>(other)
    balance <=> other.balance
  end

  def to_s
    "#{owner}: #{format("%.2f", balance)}"
  end

  def self.open(owner)
    new(owner, 100)
  end
end

class SavingsAccount < Account
  def initialize(owner, balance = 0, rate = 0.05)
    super(owner, balance)
    @rate = rate
  end

  def add_interest
    deposit(balance * @rate)
  end

  def to_s
    "#{super} (savings)"
  end
end

a = Account.new("ada").deposit(50)
b = Account.open("grace")
puts "1. chained deposit: #{a}"
puts "2. class method factory: #{b}"
puts "3. comparison: a < b is #{a < b}, a == b is #{a == b}"
puts "4. sorting: #{[b, a].sort.map(&:owner).inspect}"
puts "5. subclass: #{SavingsAccount.new("alan", 200).add_interest}"

puts "6. is_a?: #{a.is_a?(Account)}, #{a.instance_of?(Account)}"
puts "7. class hierarchy: #{SavingsAccount.ancestors.first(3).inspect}"
puts "8. respond_to?: #{a.respond_to?(:deposit)}, #{a.respond_to?(:withdraw)}"

begin
  a.deposit(-5)
rescue ArgumentError => e
  puts "9. validation error: #{e.message}"
end

puts "10. reflected instance variables: #{a.instance_variables.inspect}"
puts "11. read one with instance_variable_get: #{a.instance_variable_get(:@balance)}"

name: 07_modules.rb

# Modules: mixins, module_function, extend, namespacing, hooks.

module Greeting
  def greet
    "hello from #{self.class}"
  end
end

module Countable
  def self.included(base)
    base.extend(ClassMethods)
  end

  module ClassMethods
    def instances_seen
      @instances_seen ||= 0
    end

    def count_instance
      @instances_seen = instances_seen + 1
    end
  end

  def initialize(*)
    super
    self.class.count_instance
  end
end

module Helpers
  module_function

  def double(n)
    n * 2
  end
end

class Widget
  include Greeting
  include Countable
end

class Gadget
  include Countable
end

Widget.new
Widget.new
Gadget.new

puts "1. mixin method: #{Widget.new.greet}"
puts "2. included hook counted widgets: #{Widget.instances_seen}"
puts "3. and gadgets separately: #{Gadget.instances_seen}"
puts "4. module_function callable on the module: #{Helpers.double(21)}"

module Shoutable
  def shout
    "#{self.class.name.upcase}!"
  end
end

obj = Object.new
obj.extend(Shoutable)
puts "5. extend adds singleton methods: #{obj.shout} (own: #{obj.singleton_methods.inspect})"

module Shop
  class Order
    def to_s
      "Shop::Order"
    end
  end
end
puts "6. namespacing: #{Shop::Order.new}, resolved constant: #{Shop.const_get(:Order)}"

puts "7. included_modules: #{Widget.included_modules.include?(Greeting)}"
puts "8. ancestors order: #{Widget.ancestors.first(4).inspect}"

# Raising, rescuing, ensure, retry and custom error classes.

class InsufficientFunds < StandardError
  attr_reader :needed

  def initialize(needed, available)
    super("need #{needed}, have #{available}")
    @needed = needed
  end
end

def withdraw(balance, amount)
  raise InsufficientFunds.new(amount, balance) if amount > balance

  balance - amount
end

attempts = 0
begin
  attempts += 1
  raise "boom" if attempts < 3

  puts "1. succeeded on attempt #{attempts}"
rescue RuntimeError => e
  puts "2. attempt #{attempts} failed: #{e.message}"
  retry if attempts < 3
ensure
  puts "3. ensure runs even after retry (attempts=#{attempts})"
end

begin
  withdraw(10, 50)
rescue InsufficientFunds => e
  puts "4. custom error: #{e.message} (#{e.class}), needed=#{e.needed}"
end

def risky
  yield
rescue ZeroDivisionError => e
  "rescued #{e.class}"
else
  "no error raised"
ensure
  puts "5. ensure inside the method ran"
end
puts "6. with error: #{risky { 1 / 0 }}"
puts "7. without error: #{risky { 1 + 1 }}"

captured = begin
  Integer("nope")
rescue ArgumentError => e
  e
end
puts "8. captured: #{captured.class} - #{captured.message}"
puts "9. $! is nil outside a rescue: #{$!.inspect}"
stdout:
2. attempt 1 failed: boom
2. attempt 2 failed: boom
1. succeeded on attempt 3
3. ensure runs even after retry (attempts=3)
4. custom error: need 50, have 10 (InsufficientFunds), needed=50
5. ensure inside the method ran
6. with error: rescued ZeroDivisionError
5. ensure inside the method ran
7. without error: no error raised
8. captured: ArgumentError - invalid value for Integer(): "nope"

# Working with files and directories in a temporary sandbox.

require "tmpdir"
require "fileutils"
require "json"

Dir.mktmpdir("ruby-mcp-sample") do |dir|
  path = File.join(dir, "notes.txt")
  File.write(path, "first line\nsecond line\n")
  puts "1. exists: #{File.exist?(path)}, size: #{File.size(path)} bytes"
  puts "2. read: #{File.read(path).inspect}"
  puts "3. readlines: #{File.readlines(path, chomp: true).inspect}"

  File.open(path, "a") { |f| f.puts "third line" }
  puts "4. after append: #{File.readlines(path).length} lines"

  File.foreach(path).with_index(1) do |line, n|
    puts "5. line #{n}: #{line.strip}" if n <= 2
  end

  json_path = File.join(dir, "data.json")
  File.write(json_path, JSON.pretty_generate({ "files" => Dir.children(dir).sort }))
  puts "6. json written on disk parses back: #{JSON.parse(File.read(json_path))["files"].inspect}"

  sub = File.join(dir, "sub")
  Dir.mkdir(sub)
  Dir.glob(File.join(dir, "*.txt")).each { |f| FileUtils.cp(f, sub) }
  puts "7. copied into sub: #{Dir.children(sub).inspect}"
  puts "8. basename and extname: #{File.basename(path)} / #{File.extname(path)}"
  puts "9. dirname is the sandbox: #{File.dirname(path) == dir}"
end

puts "10. temp dir removed afterwards: #{Dir.glob(File.join(Dir.tmpdir, "ruby-mcp-sample*")).empty?}"

# Reflection and metaprogramming: method_missing, define_method, Struct, send.

class Config
  def initialize
    @values = {}
  end

  def define(key, &block)
    @values[key] = block
    self
  end

  def method_missing(name, *args)
    return @values[name].call if @values.key?(name)

    super
  end

  def respond_to_missing?(name, include_private = false)
    @values.key?(name) || super
  end
end

cfg = Config.new
cfg.define(:host) { "localhost" }.define(:port) { 8080 }
puts "1. method_missing dispatch: #{cfg.host}:#{cfg.port}"
puts "2. respond_to_missing?: #{cfg.respond_to?(:host)} / #{cfg.respond_to?(:nope)}"

begin
  cfg.nope
rescue NoMethodError => e
  puts "3. unknown key raises: #{e.class}"
end

puts "4. Struct: #{point.inspect} sum=#{point.sum} members=#{Point.members.inspect}"

# A class that includes Enumerable gets dozens of methods from one #each.

class NumberBox
  include Enumerable

  def initialize(*numbers)
    @numbers = numbers
  end

  def each
    return enum_for(:each) unless block_given?

    @numbers.each { |n| yield n }
    self
  end
end

name: 14_fibers.rb
code:
# Fibers and external enumerators: pausing and resuming work.

fiber = Fiber.new do |first|
  second = Fiber.yield(first * 2)
  third = Fiber.yield(second + 1)
  "done with #{third}"
end
puts "1. first resume: #{fiber.resume(10)}"
puts "2. second resume: #{fiber.resume(5)}"
puts "3. third resume: #{fiber.resume("last")}"
finished = begin
  fiber.resume
rescue FiberError => e
  "resuming a finished fiber raises #{e.class}"
end
puts "4. #{finished}"

counter = [1, 2].cycle
puts "5. cycle keeps going: #{counter.next}, #{counter.next}, #{counter.next}"

fib = Enumerator.new do |yielder|
  a = 0
  b = 1
  loop do
    yielder << a
    a, b = b, a + b
  end
end
puts "6. first 10 fibonacci: #{fib.first(10).inspect}"
puts "7. lazy take_while: #{fib.lazy.take_while { |n| n < 100 }.to_a.inspect}"

exhausted = begin
  [].each.next
rescue StopIteration
  "StopIteration raised"
end
puts "8. empty enumerator: #{exhausted}"
puts "9. Enumerator#with_index on a range: #{(1..3).each.with_index.map { |n, i| n * (i + 1) }.inspect}"
